pages.title: A local health-review system
paragraphs: Recommendation: use Nuxt 4 / Vue 3 / TypeScript for a stable crew interface, FastAPI / Python for data and workflow logic, and SQLite for the first local operational record. Preserve large recordings as files. Add Parquet and DuckDB for batch analysis when the selected workflow needs them.

Evaluate a local llama.cpp runtime with Qwen3.5-4B for evidence explanation and handoff drafting. The software must remain useful with the model switched off. This is a design recommendation, not a measured performance result or a flight-certified architecture.
The core product promise is: help a crew member turn trustworthy measurements into an understandable review, an authorized next step, and a traceable follow-up when Earth is unavailable.
bullets: One backend owns clinical state and every consequential transition.
The research archive, approved onboard evidence and operational crew records are different stores and release processes.
Technology is ready for a provisional choice. Hardware, the full challenge, clinical content and implementation tests remain open gates.

pages.title: What decides the stack
paragraphs: Use hard requirements before convenience. An option is unsuitable if it requires an Earth service for core review, silently changes measurement meaning, cannot recover an acknowledged record, or lets the model authorize clinical actions.

Among options that can satisfy those requirements, prefer the smallest deployment the team can explain, recover and test. Documentation establishes capabilities and constraints. It does not establish our latency, storage cost, clinical validity or team delivery speed.
bullets: Required: local cold start, record provenance, explicit time/units, revisions, durable actions and delayed transfer.
Required: purpose-limited access, visible data quality, accountable action authority and non-model fallback.
Compare: implementation effort, parser ecosystem, host compatibility, maintainability and license/redistribution obligations.
Do not invent weighted numerical scores. The Alternatives register records the actual tradeoff and the condition that would change each recommendation.
The 84-requirement baseline remains unchanged. Its 58 acceptance cases and all new implementation gates remain unexecuted.

pages.title: What offline actually means
paragraphs: The primary demo runs on one development laptop representing an onboard service node. It serves the built interface, API, record store, approved evidence and optional local model. Earth contact is an optional transfer path. Actual team hardware and flight deployment are not yet qualified.

A tablet may connect over the onboard LAN. If that link fails, it shows a connection fault and last refresh time. In this first design, the disconnected tablet does not accept authoritative record changes. A local draft is explicitly unsent.
bullets: Earth outage: local review and saving continue; released packets queue.
LAN outage: the laptop remains usable; the tablet cannot truthfully claim a server save.
Node outage: neither a cached screen nor a PWA is a replacement database. Recover the node or invoke the documented fallback.
Use a verified secure origin for LAN clients. Loopback and an ordinary HTTP LAN address are different browser security contexts.
A standalone iPad requirement would reopen ADR01 and ADR15: native storage, device permissions, conflict handling and recovery become a separate architecture.

pages.title: Web and API responsibilities
paragraphs: Nuxt builds a client-only static application. The production package contains its scripts, styles, icons and evidence-view assets locally. Nuxt routing/layout conventions support several review views without requiring a second server-side domain layer.

FastAPI owns ingestion, validation, comparisons, workflow transitions, authorization and transfer state. Generate TypeScript types from its OpenAPI contract. The frontend displays server-derived findings and sends explicit commands; it cannot bypass policy by hiding or showing a button.
bullets: Pydantic strict mode reduces type coercion, but units, time basis, censored values and clinical applicability still require explicit semantic validation.
Use bounded pagination and summarized trends for the crew view; load raw waveform windows only on demand. Never send the entire research archive to the browser.
Version the contract and return structured errors with a stable code, correlation ID, field/record location and safe retry guidance.
The UI owns stable navigation, focus, interruption recovery and visible automation state. Do not generate executable layouts or rearrange authorization controls.
Fastify and a Vite client remain valid alternatives if actual team proficiency and parser tests make them cheaper to deliver.

pages.title: Three stores with different jobs
paragraphs: Research archive: Drive holds public source material, access notes, inventories and research profiles. It is the team knowledge repository. A large archive is not a reason to load every file into an operational database or a model context.

Approved evidence: a reviewed versioned package selects the source sections, quantity mappings and applicability rules actually needed by the episode. Its manifest references exact source hashes and locators. Rights and review status govern promotion.

Operational record: a local transactional database stores identities, observations, quality, review episodes, actions, follow-ups and transfer state. Original waveforms/images and derived chunks stay in a separate managed file store.
bullets: Use different namespaces for historical research subjects, simulated operational crew and any future measured demo participant.
Never place the live SQLite DB/WAL in a Google Drive synchronization folder or a shared network filesystem.
A file hash proves byte identity, not clinical meaning, permission or authenticity of the publisher.
Unknown source rights or an unresolved unit contradiction cannot disappear because a file was successfully downloaded.

pages.title: Logical schema before table count
paragraphs: The proposed schema has 26 logical entity groups, staged by workflow. These are responsibilities and invariants, not 26 tables to build immediately. The Entities register defines grain, key fields, constraints, owner and stage for each group.

An observation retains raw value/unit, canonical quantity, reviewed mapping, specimen/method, original time, optional UTC anchoring, quality state and exact source locator. A corrected observation creates a new revision. Findings and packets depend on exact revisions, so correction can invalidate them predictably.
bullets: Use explicit subject namespaces and care relationships. A role such as commander does not imply access to all clinical details.
Use a value discriminator: decimal quantity, coded result, text, waveform reference or unavailable/censored state. Do not convert every missing value to zero.
For exact scalar quantities, retain a canonical decimal representation and compare through reviewed Decimal logic. SQLite numeric affinity alone is not an exact-decimal guarantee.
Represent large integer timestamps as decimal strings across the JavaScript JSON boundary. Keep original clock basis and reset segment.
Index common access paths: subject + quantity + time basis, current episode state + next actor, pending jobs + due time, packet + destination and source/revision dependencies.

pages.title: Durable writes and recovery
paragraphs: SQLite is proposed because the first operational workflow has one local backend owner. It is not selected because spaceflight requires SQLite. Use short transactions and serialize consequential writes through the service. Run bounded jobs outside transaction lifetimes.

For WAL, qualify the actual linked SQLite build and durability settings. The upstream WAL-reset issue is fixed in 3.51.3 and specific earlier backports. Select a maintained release with the fix and review its current advisories; a version string alone is not a release qualification.
bullets: Save an action, its audit event and an authorized outbox intent in one transaction. Acknowledge saved only after the required durable commit.
For the proposed WAL design, test synchronous=FULL, connection configuration, checkpoint growth, busy handling and disk-full behavior on the actual host.

Database and file publication are not one atomic transaction. Stage the file, verify hash/size, sync and publish it, then commit its ready manifest. Recover abandoned staging files and unreferenced objects.
Use the database backup mechanism and a matching object-manifest snapshot. Copying only a live .db file can omit required WAL state.
Name constraints. Review Alembic table-copy migrations and verify constraints after migration; automatic migration generation is not proof of preservation.

pages.title: How data becomes a review
paragraphs: The data path starts with a versioned adapter envelope. Validate file type, namespace, size, schema, identity, clock, quantity and source mapping. Persist the batch and job before acknowledging acceptance. Keep a complete ledger of accepted, quarantined, duplicate and rejected records.

The evaluation path consumes only accepted, applicable observations. Deterministic code evaluates comparable baselines, windows and source criteria. It records exact input revisions, rule and mapping versions. The resulting finding states its reason and missing context before entering the attention queue.
bullets: Use event identity and clock segment for device deduplication. Two legitimate measurements can have the same value; equal values are not duplicate evidence.
A high-rate channel stays in timestamped chunks with calibration and sample metadata. A dashboard uses versioned window summaries and coverage.
An L-/R+ research time label cannot become a precise mission timestamp merely to make a chart continuous.
OSD-569 hemoglobin mapping and ACTES RR/VO2 issues are useful failure fixtures. They are not inputs for unqualified medical interpretation.
Device acquisition gaps generate collection faults. They do not establish a physiological change.

pages.title: Automation with accountable actions
paragraphs: Use explicit domain states rather than chat history. A review episode owns attention, review, authorized action and follow-up. Jobs own ingestion, derivation, explanation and packet preparation. Each job has a lease, retry count, cancellation state and durable input/output references.

A handoff has six separate milestones: locally saved, approved for release, queued, transported, application received and clinically reviewed. Delivery uses at-least-once retries with receiver deduplication. A network success response cannot impersonate a clinician review.
bullets: An AI component can draft text and propose allowed support actions. It cannot grant its own permissions, release a packet, prescribe or clear EVA.
A released payload is immutable. Changing its source revisions, destination, purpose or content requires a new version and approval.
If a correction invalidates a queued packet, hold it. If the old packet was already delivered, retain history and prepare a correction packet for fresh release.
SSE supplies UI notifications; GET endpoints recover authoritative job and episode state after reconnection.
FastAPI background callbacks are not a durable job queue. Persist job state before dispatch; keep processing bounded and restartable.

pages.title: AI that earns its place
paragraphs: Start with a deterministic summary template. Then test whether a local model makes the explanation clearer or the draft handoff more useful without changing numbers, inventing support or bypassing authority. The model is useful only if the complete task improves.

Qwen3.5-4B is the first candidate, not a declared winner. The publisher card describes the model and Apache-2.0 license. Resolve the exact model revision, conversion/quantization provenance and runtime build before any implementation evaluation. No weights have been downloaded or benchmarked here.
bullets: Retrieve only authorized observations and approved evidence sections. Include source IDs, locators, units, time and missing context as structured inputs.
Use a small output schema: explanation claims, cited evidence IDs, missing information and draft handoff fields. Validate every number and identifier after generation.
llama.cpp structured output helps shape JSON. Schema-shaped JSON does not establish truth, citation support or authorization.
MedGemma 1.5 4B is a possible research comparator, with HAI-DEF access terms and explicit restrictions on treating outputs as direct clinical decisions.
Fine-tuning remains deferred until permitted task labels and held-out evidence demonstrate a specific benefit.

pages.title: Resource budgets without invented speed
paragraphs: A 4-billion-parameter model at an idealized 4 bits per parameter contains about 2 GB of weight bits. That is a mathematical lower-bound illustration, not a GGUF download size or total runtime-memory requirement. Quantization metadata, caches, context, activations and the rest of the application add memory.

The existing sizing model assumes 6 crew, 180 days and 10 scalar channels per crew at 1 Hz. It yields 933.12 million scalar samples and 14.93 GB for an assumed 16-byte value/time payload. A separate continuous one-channel 130 Hz waveform at 4 bytes/sample adds 48.52 GB. These are planning assumptions, not mission telemetry specifications.
bullets: The combined 63.45 GB payload excludes indexes, record metadata, WAL, original files, temporary processing, encryption and backups. Measure these costs.
First prove the small complete episode. Then test nominal 60 samples/s and a proposed 10x burst while querying and running inference.
Choose context and output limits deliberately. A model advertising a long context does not mean the host can process it efficiently.
Record p50/p95/p99, peak memory, queue depth, storage growth, restart time and rejected counts on the selected hardware.
PostgreSQL becomes relevant when concurrency or policy requirements justify it. A larger archive alone does not prove that migration is needed.

pages.title: Devices and screens: prove access
paragraphs: CSA describes Bio-Monitor as a shirt/headband/tablet system that collects physiological data. This supports the importance of integrated measurement and activity context. It does not give CHNAI LAB a public flight API, permission to connect, or a current universal astronaut screen specification.

The Polar SDK is an optional Earth-device reference, with documented Android and iOS support. A browser interface and a native SDK are different integration boundaries. Web Bluetooth has limited browser availability; a chosen tablet/browser cannot be assumed to support the sensor.
bullets: The first adapter is a replay/file import with documented schema and clocks. Label replay time and simulated operational identity visibly.
For live hardware, capture a permitted sample from the exact model/firmware. Test payload units, rates, reconnect, buffering, reset segments and access permissions.
If native access is required, a gateway uses the vendor SDK and sends a versioned envelope to the backend. The API remains the record owner.
Test the actual viewport, touch, keyboard, zoom and interrupted tasks. Do not claim NASA prefers our screen size or that old device examples establish current mission hardware.
Design the attention view around reason, evidence, missing context, next actor and follow-up; keep technical troubleshooting in its own role-limited view.

pages.title: Privacy is a data-flow property
paragraphs: Every backend operation checks actor identity, current relationship to the subject, mission/purpose and allowed data/action scope. A commander can receive an agreed operational constraint without receiving the underlying mood, genomic or clinical narrative. A technical role sees diagnostics without medical content.

The public demo uses clearly synthetic operational identities and isolated synthetic data. A role selector demonstrates a workflow; it is not production authentication. Future real-data work needs a separately tested identity and key-recovery design before ingestion.
bullets: Keep the model endpoint on a protected local boundary. It has no arbitrary SQL, shell, browsing, export or credential tool. Imported text remains data.
Filter retrieval before generation and validate output after generation. Structured output and a trusted UI catalog do not replace access control.
SQLCipher is a candidate for database encryption, but blobs, backups, temporary files, keys and recovery also need protection. Its actual merged SQLite build must be checked.
Use logs with correlation IDs, error codes, timings and counts. Exclude clinical values, names, prompt text, secrets and full packet bodies by default.
A local append-only audit helps reconstruction but does not make the host tamper-proof. Stronger integrity and operational security require separate threat testing.

pages.title: One repository, clear ownership
paragraphs: Keep one repository while the team is small. apps/web owns the interface. services/api owns domain behavior, use cases, adapters, persistence and the bounded AI boundary. contracts/generated carries derived client types. tests contains permitted fixtures and scenario definitions when implementation becomes eligible.

The database belongs to the API operationally, but its live files do not belong inside the source tree. A separate app-data directory holds the DB/WAL, objects, quarantine, model artifacts and backups. Git contains migrations and manifests, not the clinical database.
bullets: Software engineer: client/API boundary, persistence, workflow, authorization and offline packaging.
AI engineer: evidence preparation, retrieval, model experiments and output validation, collaborating on adapter semantics.
Health reviewer: applicability, comparison language and permitted action content. This role is still needed; neither engineer substitutes for clinical review.
Use generated contracts and small domain modules. Avoid duplicating clinical rules in Vue, API handlers and prompts.
Split a service only when isolation, scaling or ownership requires it. A separate model process already gives an explicit failure and resource boundary.

pages.title: A complete first demonstration
paragraphs: Recommended episode for review: a crew member reviews a newly gathered, explicitly simulated aerobic-capacity assessment against a comparable personal baseline. The interface explains the applicable NASA criterion, shows provenance and missing context, records an authorized review request, and queues a purpose-limited handoff while Earth is unavailable.

This is a proposed narrative for later implementation. The numerical examples and operational crew are simulated. NASA-STD-3001 supplies the criterion, not the invented crew record. A health reviewer must approve comparability and wording. ACTES VO2 values are not silently repurposed as astronaut VO2max.
bullets: Success branch: accepted comparable assessment, deterministic comparison, cited explanation, request for assigned CMO review and persisted follow-up. No treatment or exercise prescription.
Failure branch: ambiguous source unit or missing baseline prevents interpretation and explains what is needed. A failure branch alone does not satisfy the full challenge.
All four named health domains remain represented honestly as measured, indirect, unavailable or outside this episode; a wearable does not establish bone or immune health.
If the full statement requires different indicators or resources, remap the episode before implementation.
Show the working path live after the permitted build period. Keep the public synthetic demo available and the offline path reproducible.

pages.title: What would change this recommendation
paragraphs: Choose PostgreSQL if the actual workflow requires independent concurrent writers, stronger database-side row policies or throughput that the qualified SQLite design cannot meet. Retest migration semantics; SQLAlchemy does not make this a configuration-only migration.

Choose a native client/gateway if a disconnected tablet must make durable authoritative changes or the chosen device requires a native SDK. Choose a larger serving stack only after measured simultaneous model requests or host capabilities make it useful.
bullets: Use Vite/Fastify when demonstrated team familiarity and complete parser/contract tests reduce delivery risk. The current default is not a claim that other frameworks are obsolete.
Add embeddings only when the held-out evidence-retrieval task improves without weakening permissions or traceability.
Add fine-tuning only after an explicit labeled-data and evaluation gate. More papers in Drive do not constitute a fine-tuning dataset.
Reopen the model choice if the candidate fails number/citation checks, memory limits, latency or reliable offline initialization. Keep the non-model path.
The architecture decision log records these triggers so a change is deliberate rather than a stack rewrite driven by trends.

pages.title: Execution and release gates
paragraphs: This package finishes the documentation-based comparison. It does not claim that any application acceptance test, runtime benchmark, security test or astronaut usability study has passed. The decision register is a recommendation with explicit gates, not a deployment authorization.

The next preparation work is bounded: reconcile the October 28 challenge; inventory actual team hardware; settle one episode with a health reviewer; and resolve the data mappings and release rights that episode needs. The existing November 13 guide check remains scheduled.
bullets: During the permitted build: implement one complete path, contract/data fault fixtures, durable actions and non-model fallback before optional live devices or generative UI.
Evaluate the candidate model against templates on distinct held-out cases. Finite passing tests do not prove general medical safety.
Package all local runtime assets in advance of the offline demonstration; test cold restart without external downloads or license/identity refresh dependencies.
For public hosting, isolate synthetic data and provide durable backend storage if the demo saves state. Do not put the private research archive behind the demo URL.
Read the Decisions, Failure behavior and Evaluation gates tabs before approving a stack freeze. Keep the exact dependency/model/evidence release manifest with the eventual build.
